content.about:
Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is 22 years old (Feb 12, 2001), 181 cm tall and plays for Napoli.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia prefers to play with both feet. His jersey number is 77.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia career statistics, match ratings, heatmap and goals are available on Sofascore for current and previous seasons. Last player match was Napoli - Sampdoria (2 - 0) and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia received 7.3 Sofascore rating.

If Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is going to be in Napoli lineup, it will be confirmed on Sofascore one hour before the match starts.

If Khvicha Kvaratskhelia plays you will also be able to follow his live Sofascore rating, statistics and heatmap. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia football player profile displays all matches and competitions with statistics for all the matches Khvicha Kvaratskhelia played in. Most important stats for each competition, including average Sofascore rating, matches played, goals, assists, cards and other relevant data are also displayed.

content.about:
Napoli live scores, players, season schedule and today’s results are available on Sofascore.

Napoli next match

We may have video highlights with goals and news for some Napoli matches, but only if they play their match in one of the most popular football leagues.

Napoli previous match

Napoli previous match was against Sampdoria in Serie A, the match ended with result 2 - 0 (Napoli won the match).

Napoli fixtures tab is showing the last 100 football matches with statistics and win/draw/lose icons.

There are also all Napoli scheduled matches that they are going to play in the future.

Napoli performance and form graph is a Sofascore unique algorithm that we are generating from the team's last 10 matches, statistics, detailed analysis and our own knowledge.

This graph may help predict future Napoli matches.

Current Napoli players

Forward: Hirving Lozano, Giovanni Simeone Midfielder: Piotr Zieliński, Eljif Elmas Defender: Mário Rui, Juan Jesus Goalkeeper: Alex Meret Unknown: Victor Osimhen, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Frank Anguissa, Min-jae Kim, Tanguy Ndombélé, Giacomo Raspadori, Bartosz Bereszyński, Giovanni Di Lorenzo, Stanislav Lobotka, Matteo Politano, Amir Rrahmani, Mathías Olivera, Pierluigi Gollini, Karim Zedadka, Leo Østigård, Gianluca Gaetano, Diego Demme, Hubert Idasiak, Alessio Zerbin, Davide Marfella

The current Napoli roster, stats and player performance can be found on this page.

There are also statistics for each player in all competitions with all total played and started matches, minutes played, number of goals scored, number of cards and much more.

Napoli top scorers list is updated live during every match.

You can click on players from the roster above and see available personal information such as nationality, date of birth, height, preferred foot, position, player value, transfer history etc.

For today’s football schedule and results visit our football live score page.
